Both offices got the remaining four questions. More on the two one-office questions below -- they're part of the decisiveness numbers like everything else, just excluded from the HQ/RTP comparison later on, since there's no second office's result to compare them to. # How decisive were these results? Five of six questions were a simple either-or, so those get the usual binomial test against a 50/50 split. The sixth, "Best Email Signoff," had four options, so it gets the chi-square goodness-of-fit test instead (see the [Week Daze](../20260909_weekdaze/index.html) post for why). ::: {.cell} ::: **TL;DR:** Teams Meetings was the most one-sided call of the week -- Join right on time beat Start a few minutes early 69–21 (77%). Moving Upward was the closest thing to a real debate: Stairs edged Elevator 18–16, about as close to a coin flip as this poll has ever produced (p = 0.86) -- fittingly, it's also the one question only RTP got to weigh in on. ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}

"Cube Farm Traffic" and "Moving Upward" only ran in one office each, so there's no second office's result to compare them to -- they're dropped from everything in this section. ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} |question |Leader (overall) |HQ share |RTP share |Gap (pts) | p-value| |:------------------------|:-------------------------------|:-----------|:-----------|:---------|-------:| |EISD Tickets |Wait until its really a problem |66% (39/59) |52% (17/33) |15% | 0.249| |Teams Meetings |Join right on time |72% (41/57) |85% (28/33) |13% | 0.255| |Worst Office Temperature |Too Hot |76% (45/59) |68% (23/34) |9% | 0.509| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} |question | Options tested| Options dropped (0 votes both offices)|Chi-sq (df) | p-value| |:------------------|--------------:|--------------------------------------:|:-----------|-------:| |Best Email Signoff | 4| 0|3.1 (3) | 0.376| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![HQ vs RTP support for every option, every shared question.](index_files/figure-html/fig-hq-rtp-1.png){#fig-hq-rtp width=672} ::: ::: HQ and RTP picked the exact same winner on all four shared questions this week -- no flips, and the running flip tally holds at **11**. The Alignment Index for this poll alone comes out to **0.9**, and the cumulative index sits at **0.89**. With total agreement on every winner and reasonably similar enthusiasm across the board, this was a quiet week for office tension. # Do the procrastinators run hot? "Wait until it's really a problem" swept EISD Tickets, and "Too Hot" swept Worst Office Temperature -- both landslides, and both questions drew almost identical crowds. Let's bound how much the "let it boil over" types overlap. ::: {.cell} ::: Of the 92 overlapping voters, the ticket-procrastinating, thermostat-blaming crowd could be as small as 31 or as large as 56 people (34%–61%), versus about 41 (45%) expected if the two opinions were unrelated. Both landslides are large enough that the floor sits well above zero -- there's a real, forced overlap here, not just a coincidence of two big majorities.
